title: Protocol for Probing Regulated Lysosomal Activity and Function in Living Cells
protocol: On the day of the experiment, dilute the β-glucosidase substrate (stock concentration of 5 mM) to a working concentration between 5 – 20 μM in DMEM with or without 10% FBS.
Incubate cells plated at 30%–60% confluency on coverslips in 12-well dishes with β-Glucosidase substrate in DMEM for 20 min at 37°C in a 5% CO2 atmosphere.
Wash the wells three times gently with ice-cold PBS (0.5 mL per well) to remove the probe.
Fix cells for 15 min in 4% PFA diluted in PBS (0.5 mL per well) at 20°C with limited light exposure.
Wash with PBS three times to remove PFA (0.5 mL per well).
Block cells for 1 h in blocking buffer containing 5% goat serum, 5% bovine serum albumin, PBS, sodium azide.
Mount cells in mounting media with DAPI onto a standard mounting glass slide.
Apply mounting medium with DAPI onto glass microscope slide using 20 μL per each coverslip.
Check that there are no air bubbles in the pipette tip and lay down coverslip onto the mounting medium slowly to avoid air bubbles from forming.
Dry in dark area at 20°C for 16 h prior to imaging.
Incubate cells with β-Glucosidase substrate in DMEM for 20 min at 37°C in 5% CO2 atmosphere (500 μL per well).
Wash with ice-cold PBS three times to remove the probe (0.5 mL per well).
Dilute SiR-Lysosome from a 1 mM stock concentration to a working concentration of 1 μM in DMEM.
Add 0.5 μL of probe per 500 μL of DMEM.
Optionally, include 10% FBS in the solution.
Do not add antibiotics to the solution.
Add verapamil to SiR-Lysosome DMEM solution to achieve a working concentration of 1 μM.
Ensure final DMSO concentration does not exceed 2% in the SiR-Lysosome DMEM solution.
Incubate cells with SiR-Lysosome in DMEM for 5 – 60 min at 37°C in 5% CO2 atmosphere (500 μL per well).
Wash cells with ice-cold PBS three times to remove the probe (0.5 mL per well).
Fix cells for 15 min using 4% PFA diluted in PBS at 20°C with limited light exposure (0.5 mL per well).
Wash cells with PBS three times to remove PFA (0.5 mL per well).
Mount cells in mounting media with DAPI onto a standard mounting glass slide.
Apply mounting medium with DAPI onto glass microscope slide using 20 μL per coverslip.
Dry the slides in dark area at 20°C for 16 h prior to imaging.
Store covered slips at 4°C where staining does not fade for at least two weeks.
Use cells plated in an 8-well chamber at 30%–60% confluency for live-cell analyses.
Incubate cells with 1 μM SiR-Lysosome in DMEM for 5 – 60 min at 37°C in a 5% CO2 atmosphere (500 μL per well).
Wash cells three times with ice-cold PBS to remove the probe (0.5 mL per well).
Insert cell chamber for live imaging under conditions of 37°C and 5% CO2.
Image cells for 1 hour at an acquisition rate of 1 frame every 30 seconds.
Monitor changes in lysosomal pH in living cells using LysoSensor Yellow/Blue DND-160.
Incubate cells with LysoSensor Yellow/Blue DND-160 to detect fluctuations in lysosomal pH.
Analyze fluorescence emitted by LysoSensor to trace lysosomal pH gradients.
Dilute LysoSensor (stock concentration of 1 mM) in DMEM to a working concentration in the range of 1 – 200 μM.
Incubate cells with LysoSensor in DMEM for 5 min at 37°C in a 5% CO2 atmosphere.
Wash cells with ice-cold PBS three times to remove the probe (0.5 mL per well).
Wash cells with PBS three times to remove PFA (0.5 mL per well).
Mount cells in mounting media (without DAPI) onto a standard mounting glass slide.
Apply 20 μL of mounting medium (without DAPI) onto each coverslip slowly to avoid air bubbles from forming.
Dry the mounted slides in a dark area at 20°C for 16 hours prior to imaging.
Store dried coverslips at 4°C where staining does not fade for at least two weeks.
Incubate cells with LysoSensor in DMEM for 5 minutes at 37°C in a 5% CO2 atmosphere (500 μL per well).
Wash with ice-cold PBS three times to remove the probe (0.5 mL per well).
Insert cell chamber for live imaging at 37°C in 5% CO2.
Image cells for 1 hour with an image acquisition rate of 1 frame every 30 seconds.
Plate cells onto coverslips 24 hours prior to experiments.
Incubate cells with lysosomal tracers before or during drug treatments.
Add GSK3 inhibitors (40 mM LiCl or 8 nM CHIR99021) or controls (40 mM NaCl or DMSO) a few minutes prior or together with medium plus lysosomal tracers.
Incubate cells with Wnt3a (100 ng/mL) and control buffer in DMEM, according to probe recommendations.
Add cycloheximide (20 μg/mL) at least 4 hours before incubation with DMEM + lysosomal tracer for protein synthesis inhibition.
Transfect desired DNA into cells 24 hours prior to lysosomal assays as per lipofectamine 2000 manufacturer protocols.
Dilute Bovine Serum Albumin DeQuenched (BSA-DQ) to a concentration of 5 μg/mL in DMEM.
Incubate cells with the diluted BSA-DQ solution for 30 minutes.
Wash cells three times with PBS.
Fix cells in 4% PFA diluted in PBS (0.5 mL per well).
Wash cells three times with PBS to remove PFA.
Permeabilize cells using digitonin at a concentration of 6.5 μg/mL or Triton X-100 at 0.15%, both diluted in PBS (0.5 mL per well).
Wash cells three times with PBS to remove the detergent.
Block cells for 1 hour in blocking buffer containing 5% goat serum, 5% bovine serum albumin, PBS, and sodium azide (0.5 mL per well).
Incubate primary antibodies diluted in blocking buffer with cells for 1 hour at 20°C under limited light exposure (0.5 mL per well).
Wash cells three times with PBS (0.5 mL per well).
Incubate secondary antibodies diluted in blocking buffer with cells for 40 min at 20°C (0.5 mL per well).
Wash cells three times with PBS (0.5 mL per well).
Mount cells in mounting media without DAPI.
Dry mounted samples in a dark area at 20°C for 16 h prior to imaging.
